preconditions.description: The number of students n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
The number of pairs of acquaintances m is between 0 and 500,000 inclusive.
The number of groups k is between 2 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i <= k for c_i in c)
preconditions.description: Each student's group number c_i is between 1 and k inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for a_i, b_i in acquaintances)
preconditions.description: Each acquaintance pair (a_i, b_i) consists of students with numbers between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in acquaintances)
preconditions.description: No student is acquainted with themselves.

preconditions.expression: len(set((a_i, b_i) for a_i, b_i in acquaintances)) == m
preconditions.description: Each acquaintance pair (a_i, b_i) is unique.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(k) for j in range(i+1, k) if is_bipartite(group_students[i], group_students[j], acquaintances))
postconditions.description: The output is the number of ways to choose two different groups such that it's possible to divide the students of those groups into two teams with no acquaintance pairs inside each team.
